title: Living Birds
subtitle: Living Birds is a fully automated collection of realistic birds for any game
description:
Living Birds is a fully automated collection of realistic birds for any game. In less than a minute you can have singing, animated and fully AI driven birds in your game. Each bird is under 730 tris and includes 2 songs unique to its species. The system dynamically updates bird targets, spawning, unspawning, and all bird actions so you don't have to worry about anything.

NOW INCLUDING CROWS!


Features:
-AI driven realistic birds
-New collision avoidence system
-7 species, 14 unique birdsongs
-Pause independent of Time.timeScale
-dynamic bird target loading/unloading
-730 triangle models
